company.name: AutoStore
company.shortDescription: AutoStore is a automated storage and retrieval system.
company.description: AutoStore is a unique world-wide patented warehouse system proven to be the ideal small-goods handler for any warehouse, old or new. With standardized boxes stacked in a cube, it is easily the most space-efficient goods-to-man system on the market and can double storing capacity without increasing footprint. AutoStore is sold via a global multi-distribution network.

productsAndServices.description: A modular goods-to-person automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) using robots, bins, a grid, workstations, and a controller to store and retrieve inventory.
productsAndServices.name: AutoStore System

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that connects AutoStore system design, simulation, operations, analytics, and predictive diagnosis in a unified environment.
productsAndServices.name: CubeVerse™

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven optimization layer that analyzes operational and simulation data to improve AutoStore throughput, identify constraints, and anticipate potential disruptions.
productsAndServices.name: AutoStore Intelligence™

productsAndServices.description: A compact AutoStore-based warehouse automation solution for small and medium-sized businesses, available through a robots-as-a-service model.
productsAndServices.name: Pio

productsAndServices.description: A fulfillment software platform listed in AutoStore’s system portfolio for coordinating warehouse fulfillment processes and automation operations.
productsAndServices.name: Qubit™ Fulfillment Platform

productsAndServices.description: Consulting and engineering services that configure and simulate AutoStore systems to match a facility’s space, inventory, throughput, and operational requirements before deployment.
productsAndServices.name: AutoStore System Design and Simulation Services
